_comment: CodeQL results of security-severity >= 7.0 accepted after review (WP83, ADR-0045). The codeql workflow fails on any other High/Critical result (scripts/sarif-gate.py --fail-on high).

Every entry needs rule, path, fingerprint (scripts/sarif-gate.py --suggest prints it), reason and expires (at most six months ahead; a finding waiting for a fix expires when the fix is due). 'line' is informational.

accepted.reason: True positive, Low (review Round 5 SD-01): `page` is only bounded below (@Min(0), contract minimum 0), so page * size overflows int for a huge page: a negative offset makes Hibernate throw (500) or a wrapped one returns another page of the caller's own data. No cross-tenant read (RLS). WP84: compute the offset as a long with Math.multiplyExact or give `page` a maximum in libs/contracts common.yaml and the resources.
